title: The Realm of the NAO: the script
how: One clip per item. Record "spoken" where it is given, otherwise "text", with the item's voice, and save it as <id>.wav; convert to mono mp3 at about 64 kbps and place it at the item's "audio" path beside the HTML. Designed voices: first call design_voice with the description and save_as the name on the voice's test item, then use speak with that name for every item. Items marked dynamic change with the visitor's choices: their clip is used only while the words match the text here, and the browser's voice reads them otherwise.

voices.speaker: wren
voices.name: Wren
voices.description: a bright, quick woman in her thirties, light Irish lilt, energetic, smiling

voices.speaker: noor
voices.name: Noor
voices.description: a calm young woman, soft, unhurried, gently amused

voices.speaker: ilse

voices.description: a steady older woman, Dutch-accented English, dry humour, patient

voices.speaker: bram

voices.description: a deep, slow, kind man, a little gravel, Dutch-accented English

voices.speaker: council
voices.name: The Council
voices.description: a measured woman in her fifties, thoughtful, pausing, kind authority

voices.speaker: dagny
voices.name: Dagny
voices.description: a sharp, playful woman, Scandinavian-accented English, quick, delighted by numbers

voices.speaker: osei

voices.speaker: priya

voices.speaker: mireille

voices.speaker: agnes
voices.name: Agnes

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: What this is. This is a living map of how the NAOMS cooperative moves money and work. You'll walk it in eight short chapters, with the people who live here.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: What you're looking at. The land is the cooperative, a boundaried commons. Water is money: where it rains, money arrives, and where it runs, money moves. Each building is a role, and each role has a person you can follow.
items.where: Welcome, page 2: What you're looking at

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Who the players are. Meet the troupe. Each of them leads you through a part of the realm.
items.where: Welcome, page 3: Who the players are

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Where to start. Begin with the artisans who are opening hives right now.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The narrator is the voice of the map, and tells the story as you walk.
items.where: Welcome, page 3: the cast, The narrator

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Wren is a Hive Instigator: she opens hives and invites artisans in.

items.speaker: wren
items.name: Wren
items.text: I've a project ready and a hill picked out. Who's with me?

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Taavi is an artisan: he builds on NAOMS and does quests.

items.speaker: taavi
items.name: Taavi
items.text: A quest, a fair price, and patronage points in my jar. Perfect.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Noor is a member: she pays her dues and uses the free apps.

items.speaker: noor
items.name: Noor
items.text: Twenty euros a month, and the apps just work. Tea?

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Ilse and Bram are the Forge team: they build and run the NAOMS infrastructure.

items.speaker: ilse
items.name: Ilse
items.text: We keep the fires lit so everyone else can build.

items.speaker: bram
items.name: Bram
items.text: And the coffee never runs out.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The Council is a circle of five: it divides the dues with discernment.
items.where: Welcome, page 3: the cast, The Council

items.speaker: council
items.name: The Council
items.text: We look, we talk, and we choose. No fixed rule.
items.where: Welcome, page 3: the cast, The Council

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Dagny is a backer: she brings water and steers it with tokens.

items.speaker: dagny
items.name: Dagny
items.text: Squares! I do love a good square.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Osei is an investor: he brings larger capital into a fund.

items.speaker: osei
items.name: Osei
items.text: A fine river, and a fine place for my trunk to land.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Priya is a fund manager: she decides how her fund is spent.

items.speaker: priya
items.name: Priya
items.text: Neat piles, many streams. That's how a fund becomes a river.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Ferran is a connector: he brings investors to a fund.

items.speaker: ferran
items.name: Ferran
items.text: I know every bend of the mountain road, and everyone on it.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Mireille is a guild member: her craft travels from hive to hive.

items.speaker: mireille
items.name: Mireille
items.text: Have toolkit, will travel. Which hive needs me today?

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Agnes is an ancestor: she built a part of all this, long ago.

items.speaker: agnes
items.name: Agnes
items.text: Goodness. Did all that grow from my little sketch?

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: And the traveller at the Gate is you.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Chapter 1. The artisans arrive. A Hive Instigator opens a hive and invites an artisan in. Quests, patronage points, and a hive's own rules.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Artisans are arriving in the realm, and many bring a project already in hand.

items.speaker: wren
items.name: Wren
items.text: I'm Wren. I've a project ready, and I'm here to build it on NAOMS.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Wren buys in to build on NAOMS, and walks in to choose a site for a new hive.

items.speaker: wren
items.name: Wren
items.text: This hill catches the light. It'll do nicely.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: She opens a hive: a team of artisans with one chest for all its money.

items.speaker: wren
items.name: Wren
items.text: One chest, so we always know what we have.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: As its Hive Instigator, she invites other artisans to work with her.

items.speaker: wren
items.name: Wren
items.text: Taavi! Come and build with us.

items.speaker: taavi
items.name: Taavi
items.text: Taavi, at your service. Where do I start?

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Work is offered as quests, each sized in euros before it begins.

items.speaker: wren
items.name: Wren
items.text: This quest is worth a hundred euros. Agreed?

items.speaker: taavi
items.name: Taavi
items.text: Agreed!

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: A quest of 100 euros earns 100 patronage points, one for one, agreed before the work.

items.speaker: taavi
items.name: Taavi
items.text: A hundred patronage points in my jar. Listen to them rattle.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The hive sets its own rules: how it pays out from its chest, how it organises its patronage points, and what caps it offers.

items.speaker: wren
items.name: Wren
items.text: Our cap starts high while the work is new and risky, and comes down once our app is selling.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Taavi's rent is due this week. What does he do? Cash now from the chest, set against a later patronage point payout. Or: Patronage points and patience, patronage point payouts will fill his patronage points as the hive earns.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The hive pays him from its chest now, and sets it against a later patronage point payout.
items.where: Chapter 1, step b08, if "Cash now from the chest", b01: caption

items.speaker: taavi
items.name: Taavi
items.text: Rent sorted. Thanks, Wren!
items.where: Chapter 1, step b08, if "Cash now from the chest", b01: line

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: His patronage points wait in the jar, to be filled by patronage point payouts as the hive earns.
items.where: Chapter 1, step b08, if "Patronage points and patience", b01: caption

items.speaker: taavi
items.name: Taavi
items.text: I can wait. The jar isn't going anywhere.
items.where: Chapter 1, step b08, if "Patronage points and patience", b01: line

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: A hive has opened, an artisan has joined it, and the first patronage points are in a jar.

items.speaker: wren
items.name: Wren
items.text: Now, let's see where the members' money goes.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Chapter 1 walked. Next comes chapter 2: The members' 20 euros.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Chapter 2. The members' 20 euros. A member's dues pool in the Treasury, and the Council divides them with discernment. The Forge team, the millraces, the line, the surplus.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Noor is a member: she pays 20 euros a month and uses the free apps.

items.speaker: noor
items.name: Noor
items.text: Tea, headphones, and apps that simply work. Lovely.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Her 20 euros fall as rain on the springs and pool in the Treasury.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Here the Council looks at what has arrived and at the whole realm, and decides with discernment where the water goes.

items.speaker: council
items.name: The Council
items.text: There is no fixed rule. Each month we look, we talk, and we choose what serves the greatest good.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Its hand moves over several gates in no set order: sometimes the Forge fills first, sometimes the millraces run first.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Water goes to the Forge team, who build and run the NAOMS infrastructure, up to the floor the Council has set.

items.speaker: ilse
items.name: Ilse
items.text: The Council presses from above, we say what we need from below, and we meet in the middle.

items.speaker: bram
items.name: Bram
items.text: And we pay each other from the Forge's chest. Coffee?

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Water runs down the millraces to the hives whose apps are free to members, wider for the apps that are used more.

items.speaker: noor
items.name: Noor
items.text: I use the planting calendar every day, so its wheel spins fastest.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Water flows along the payout and appreciation line, to those who already hold NAOMS's patronage points and to NAOMS's own ancestors in the Grove.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Once the Forge and the free apps have what they need, the Council decides where the surplus goes. Sit in the circle: where would you send it? Invest in Thistledown, a new hive whose water waits in the Marshes. Or: Match what Lanternhill's backers put in, into Lanternhill's chest, through its gate.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The surplus flows into Thistledown's chest: the decision is made, and the hive's water leaves the Marshes.
items.where: Chapter 2, step b08, if "Invest in Thistledown", b01: caption

items.speaker: council
items.name: The Council
items.text: The cooperative holds Thistledown's patronage points now, like any investor.
items.where: Chapter 2, step b08, if "Invest in Thistledown", b01: line

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The surplus matches what Lanternhill's backers bring, and flows through its gate into the hive's chest.
items.where: Chapter 2, step b08, if "Match what Lanternhill's backers put in", b01: caption

items.speaker: council
items.name: The Council
items.text: The cooperative holds Lanternhill's patronage points now, like any investor.
items.where: Chapter 2, step b08, if "Match what Lanternhill's backers put in", b01: line

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: After 31 months of dues, Noor is a lifetime member, and the rain from her stops.

items.speaker: noor
items.name: Noor
items.text: Lifetime! I'll still be here, with my tea.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Noor's friend joins too. How does he pay? 20 euros a month, lifetime after 31 months. Or: 460 euros at once, on Hearthfield's referral, lifetime from the first day.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: His 20 euros a month join the rain, and in 31 months he is lifetime too.
items.where: Chapter 2, step b10, if "20 euros a month", b01: caption

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: 92 of his 460 euros go straight into Hearthfield's chest, and the rest pools in the Treasury.
items.where: Chapter 2, step b10, if "460 euros at once, on Hearthfield's referral", b01: caption

items.speaker: noor
items.name: Noor
items.text: Hearthfield told him about it, so Hearthfield gets the thanks.
items.where: Chapter 2, step b10, if "460 euros at once, on Hearthfield's referral", b01: line

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The members' money pools in the Treasury, and the Council divides it with discernment.

items.speaker: council
items.name: The Council
items.text: And next month, we'll look again.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Chapter 2 walked. Next comes chapter 3: An app's life.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Chapter 3. An app's life. From the workshop to the Harbour Market, out of the chest in organised flows, and into the Open Sea.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: In Lanternhill's workshop, Wren's hive finishes version 1 of its app.

items.speaker: wren
items.name: Wren
items.text: Version 1 of the lamp-lighter. It's ready!

items.speaker: taavi
items.name: Taavi
items.text: I still have ink on my hands.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The app is released into the Harbour Market, the realm's app store.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: How does Lanternhill offer its app? Free to members, the millrace runs, in proportion to use. Or: For sale, each sale sends 80% to the chest and 20% to the Treasury.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: A millrace opens to Lanternhill, and the more members use the app, the faster its wheel turns.
items.where: Chapter 3, step b03, if "Free to members", b01: caption

items.speaker: noor
items.name: Noor
items.text: I'm trying it tonight.
items.where: Chapter 3, step b03, if "Free to members", b01: line

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: A buyer pays Lanternhill's price: 80% flows into the hive's chest and 20% into the Treasury.
items.where: Chapter 3, step b03, if "For sale", b01: caption

items.speaker: wren
items.name: Wren
items.text: Sold apps draw no millrace. Our buyers carry us instead.
items.where: Chapter 3, step b03, if "For sale", b01: line

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Out of its chest, the hive organises its flows: patronage point payouts first, then appreciation.

items.speaker: wren
items.name: Wren
items.text: Patronage point payouts, then the Grove, then the aqueducts. Every month, in that order.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: A patronage point payout is shared in proportion to patronage points held: 100 of 5,000 patronage points means 2% of the payout.

items.speaker: taavi
items.name: Taavi
items.text: Two percent of a thousand euros is twenty euros, and my patronage points fill a little.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Appreciation flows to the ancestors whose work the app grew from, through the Grove.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Along the aqueducts, appreciation flows to the partners and foundations the app stands on.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Month by month the granary fills, until the app needs no more revenue.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Then version 1 sails into the Open Sea, free for all, and the water it drew stops.

items.speaker: wren
items.name: Wren
items.text: Off you go. Light up the world.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The workshop is already at work on version 2, which issues new patronage points and needs the water again.

items.speaker: wren
items.name: Wren
items.text: Version 2 has a great many more lamps.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: And when a decision is pending, the water waits in the Marshes until it clears.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: That is an app's life: built, released, filled, and given to the commons. Back in the present, all of it lies ahead.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Chapter 3 walked. Next comes chapter 4: Steering.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Chapter 4. Steering. A backer brings water and receives tokens, then votes at the gates. Stack or spread.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Dagny is a backer, and she brings water to the realm.

items.speaker: dagny
items.name: Dagny
items.text: Seven euros a token, and I'll take the full 144.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Her 1,008 euros flow into the Treasury, and she walks away with 144 tokens.

items.speaker: dagny
items.name: Dagny
items.text: They never turn into cash again, and holding them longer earns me nothing. So I'll use them.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: At the gates she spends tokens as votes: n votes on one hive cost n squared tokens, so 1, 4, 9, 16.

items.speaker: dagny
items.name: Dagny
items.text: Squares! Many small voices outweigh one loud one.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: How does Dagny spend her 144 tokens? Twelve votes on Lanternhill, 144 tokens, twelve lots of patronage points. Or: One vote each on twelve hives, 12 tokens, twelve lots of patronage points, 132 kept for hives still to come.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Lanternhill's gate opens wide, and Treasury water flows into its chest in proportion to the votes.
items.where: Chapter 4, step b04, if "Twelve votes on Lanternhill", b01: caption

items.speaker: dagny
items.name: Dagny
items.text: Wren's lamps deserve it.
items.where: Chapter 4, step b04, if "Twelve votes on Lanternhill", b01: line

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Twelve gates open a little, and 132 tokens stay in her satchel for hives still to come.
items.where: Chapter 4, step b04, if "One vote each on twelve hives", b01: caption

items.speaker: dagny
items.name: Dagny
items.text: A little water everywhere, and plenty left over.
items.where: Chapter 4, step b04, if "One vote each on twelve hives", b01: line

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Each hive answers her votes with its patronage points, the number decided by the hive.

items.speaker: dagny
items.name: Dagny
items.text: Twelve lots of patronage points either way, and spreading costs a fraction of the tokens.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: A friend sees a hive Dagny cannot. Does she gift her some tokens? Gift 16 tokens, her friend casts 4 votes. Or: Keep them for hives still to come.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Her friend spends them on a farther hive Dagny had never heard of, and its gate opens a little.
items.where: Chapter 4, step b06, if "Gift 16 tokens", b01: caption

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: They wait in her satchel; new hives keep arriving.
items.where: Chapter 4, step b06, if "Keep them for hives still to come", b01: caption

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Her satchel is empty now; next time she might gift a few tokens before she votes.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Backers steer their own water: the gates open by their votes, and the hives' patronage points come back to them.

items.speaker: dagny
items.name: Dagny
items.text: Same time next month?

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Chapter 4 walked. Next comes chapter 5: Investing.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Chapter 5. Investing. An investor, a connector's 7%, and a fund that spreads its water many ways.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Osei is an investor, and Ferran the connector has walked him down from the mountains.

items.speaker: ferran
items.name: Ferran
items.text: Best view in the realm, and the best fund at the end of it.

items.speaker: osei
items.name: Osei
items.text: I can see why you walk this road.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Osei's 10,000 euros come down the Great River into a fund.

items.speaker: osei
items.name: Osei
items.text: Here you are. I trust you to choose well.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Ferran receives 7% of the investment along the road in: 700 euros.

items.speaker: ferran
items.name: Ferran
items.text: Bringing a member through the Gate earns no coin, and that keeps our trust real. Investors are another matter.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: What does Ferran do with his 700 euros? Keep it. Or: Share it onward, with the friend who helped him make the introduction.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: He keeps it.
items.where: Chapter 5, step b04, if "Keep it", b01: caption

items.speaker: ferran
items.name: Ferran
items.text: A good walk and a good fee.
items.where: Chapter 5, step b04, if "Keep it", b01: line

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Part of it runs on to the friend who helped make the introduction.
items.where: Chapter 5, step b04, if "Share it onward", b01: caption

items.speaker: ferran
items.name: Ferran
items.text: She made the first call. Half the credit is hers.
items.where: Chapter 5, step b04, if "Share it onward", b01: line

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Priya and the other fund managers decide how the fund is spent, and they spread it.

items.speaker: priya
items.name: Priya
items.text: Two thousand here, a thousand there, and small piles for quests.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The water splits into many streams: into hives' chests, to single quests, and matching what a hive's own backers put in.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: A fund directs its money four ways: into a chest, to a quest, toward a star, or by matching.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The hives answer the fund's water with their patronage points, and as they pay out, the fund reinvests.

items.speaker: priya
items.name: Priya
items.text: The point of a fund is to become a river.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: There is room beside it for more lakes: many funds can grow in the realm.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Investors cast no votes: fund managers decide, connectors are thanked, and hives answer with patronage points.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Chapter 5 walked. Next comes chapter 6: Across hives.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Chapter 6. Across hives. A guild member quests in three hives, and the aqueducts carry appreciation between them.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Mireille belongs to a guild, a craft practised across hives, and this hall is its home.

items.speaker: mireille
items.name: Mireille
items.text: We train here, we eat here, and we argue about tools here.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: She sets out to do quests in three hives, starting with Millbrook.

items.speaker: mireille
items.name: Mireille
items.text: Millbrook needs a map that folds properly.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: In each hive she earns that hive's patronage points, one for one with the euros of the quest.

items.speaker: mireille
items.name: Mireille
items.text: Lanternhill next. Wren has lamps that need hanging.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: And in each she stands on the hive's attribution list, for the parts she made.

items.speaker: mireille
items.name: Mireille
items.text: Riverbend last, and then supper at the hall.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Between the hives, the aqueducts run wide or narrow, as the hives have agreed.

items.speaker: mireille
items.name: Mireille
items.text: Lanternhill and Millbrook settled theirs over tea. Generosity is the practice here.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Mireille believes in Riverbend, downstream of Lanternhill. Does she stake her Lanternhill patronage points there? Stake them on Riverbend, their patronage point payouts flow there as funding. Or: Keep them in Lanternhill, its patronage point payouts come to her.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The patronage point payouts her Lanternhill patronage points would receive now flow to Riverbend as funding, and Riverbend gives her its patronage points.
items.where: Chapter 6, step b06, if "Stake them on Riverbend", b01: caption

items.speaker: mireille
items.name: Mireille
items.text: What goes around comes back around.
items.where: Chapter 6, step b06, if "Stake them on Riverbend", b01: line

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: She keeps them where they are, and Lanternhill's patronage point payouts come to her.
items.where: Chapter 6, step b06, if "Keep them in Lanternhill", b01: caption

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Guilds carry craft across hives, and the aqueducts carry appreciation between them.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Chapter 6 walked. Next comes chapter 7: Remembering.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Chapter 7. Remembering. An ancestor's invitation arrives, and appreciation flows to her from a hive and from the Treasury.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Years ago, Agnes built a part of what NAOMS now is.

items.speaker: agnes
items.name: Agnes
items.text: Oh, a long time ago. We had no idea what it would become.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Who is remembered here today? Agnes, who built a part of it. Or: A family supporter, who carried the cost at home, shown with privacy respected.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The family who carried the cost of the work can be on the list too, with their privacy respected.
items.where: Chapter 7, step b02, if "A family supporter", b01: caption

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: An invitation arrives: her name is on Hearthfield's attribution list, with a share agreed before the first euro moved.

items.speaker: agnes
items.name: Agnes
items.text: Hearthfield? I drew the very first sketch of that calendar!

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Appreciation flows to her from Hearthfield's chest, through the Grove, up to the agreed amount.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The Treasury's appreciation reaches NAOMS's own ancestors through the same Grove.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: How should she appear on the list? With her name. Or: Counted, with her name kept private.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: She logs in, accepts, and sees what her contribution grew into.

items.speaker: agnes
items.name: Agnes
items.text: Look at all those lamps!

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Every hive remembers its ancestors, and the realm remembers its own.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Chapter 7 walked. Next comes chapter 8: The Gate.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Chapter 8. The Gate. You stand where you began. Someone vouches for you, you become a spring, and the Gate opens.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: You stand where you began, outside the Gate.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Someone who knows the work vouches for you. How do you come in? They give you a membership token, one month, bought for 20 euros. Or: You pay your own 20 euros, one month, paid directly.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: A wax seal: one month of membership, bought for the same 20 euros as a month paid directly.
items.where: Chapter 8, step b02, if "They give you a membership token", b01: caption

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The Gate lets you through; every traveller is vouched for, freely.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: You become a spring, and your 20 euros fall as rain.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: A membership carries no vote. Do you want a voice at the gates? Buy Flow Tokens, 7 euros each, up to 144. Or: Not yet, walk the realm a while first.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: You join the backers on their hill, tokens in hand.
items.where: Chapter 8, step b05, if "Buy Flow Tokens", b01: caption

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: There is no hurry; Flow Tokens can wait for hives still to come.
items.where: Chapter 8, step b05, if "Not yet", b01: caption

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Look at the realm behind you: your own choices have shaped it and brought it to life.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The Gate opens, and the cooperative invites you to join.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Chapter 8 walked. You have walked all eight chapters, and the Gate is open.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The NAOMS cooperative, a boundaried commons. The whole realm is the cooperative, a boundaried commons. It sells memberships, membership tokens and Flow Tokens, and holds whatever patronage points the realm earns by investing. The Treasury is an organ within it. Under the lens: the wall that bounds the commons.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Members, the springs. €20 a month, or €460 at once for life (23 months); pay monthly and after 31 months you are lifetime. A membership token is one month, bought to give or to use. Members use the free apps. No vote. Under the lens: Noor's raindrop; a membership token handed to a friend.
items.spoken: Members, the springs. 20 euros a month, or 460 euros at once for life (23 months); pay monthly and after 31 months you are lifetime. A membership token is one month, bought to give or to use. Members use the free apps. No vote. Under the lens: Noor's raindrop; a membership token handed to a friend.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: This month: about €50,000 of dues. Lifetime fees bought on a hive's referral send 20% to that hive: about €1,500 this month. Amounts are for an illustrative month.
items.spoken: This month: about 50,000 euros of dues. Lifetime fees bought on a hive's referral send 20% to that hive: about 1,500 euros this month. Amounts are for an illustrative month.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The Gate. Invite-only; every traveller vouched for, freely. The whole land is a boundaried commons. It opens once you have walked the eight chapters. Under the lens: a traveller let through.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Chapters walked: 0 of 8. The Gate is still closed. Amounts are for an illustrative month.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The Council, the Treasury. Where the dues pool and the Council decides, by discernment and with no fixed rule, how they flow: to the Forge, down the millraces, to the payout and appreciation line, and onward as surplus to invest or match. What leaves is money alone, into chests. The backers' water waits beside it for their votes. Under the lens: the circle of five at the water-table, moving the gates.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: This month: about €50,500 of dues and app-sale shares in the Council's care. About €28,000 of backers' water, steered only by their votes. This month's surplus waits for the Council's decision. Amounts are for an illustrative month.
items.spoken: This month: about 50,500 euros of dues and app-sale shares in the Council's care. About 28,000 euros of backers' water, steered only by their votes. This month's surplus waits for the Council's decision. Amounts are for an illustrative month.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The usage stream, the millraces. Dues flow to the apps that are free to members, in proportion to use, covering costs and filling the patronage points those apps issued. When an app needs no more revenue, it sails into the commons and the race runs dry. Under the lens: a wheel turning with use, a granary filling.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: the planting calendar: about €10,700 this month, 35% of the way to needing no more; the mill map: about €4,860 this month, 15% of the way to needing no more. Amounts are for an illustrative month.
items.spoken: the planting calendar: about 10,700 euros this month, 35% of the way to needing no more; the mill map: about 4,860 euros this month, 15% of the way to needing no more. Amounts are for an illustrative month.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The payout and appreciation line. Dues the Council sets aside to pay out on patronage points already held in NAOMS by those who invested time or money, and to give appreciation to NAOMS's own ancestors. Under the lens: patronage point payouts settling at the Forge's chest; a flow into the Grove.
items.where: Panel: The payout and appreciation line

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: This month: about €7,770 along the line. Amounts are for an illustrative month.
items.spoken: This month: about 7,770 euros along the line. Amounts are for an illustrative month.
items.where: Panel: The payout and appreciation line

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The Forge team, the Forge. Builds and runs the NAOMS infrastructure. The Council sets its budget, pressure from above meeting needs from below. Its river holds steady while the realm grows. The Forge team pays each other from the Forge's chest. Under the lens: Ilse and Bram at the bellows, the floor filling.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The floor the Council has set: about €15,000 a month. The floor is filled this month. Amounts are for an illustrative month.
items.spoken: The floor the Council has set: about 15,000 euros a month. The floor is filled this month. Amounts are for an illustrative month.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Hives, villages and chests. Teams of artisans, one chest each, opened by a Hive Instigator. A hive runs several workshops and releases apps; it pays out from its chest by its own culture and rules, and 20% of every lifetime membership bought on its referral is its own. Under the lens: Wren at the gate of her hive; a chest paying out in organised channels.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Into each chest this month: Hearthfield, about €24,000; Riverbend, about €20,500; Lanternhill, a hive site still waiting; Thistledown, about €2,430 waiting in the Marshes; Millbrook, about €8,790; the farther hives, about €6,270. Amounts are for an illustrative month.
items.spoken: Into each chest this month: Hearthfield, about 24,000 euros; Riverbend, about 20,500 euros; Lanternhill, a hive site still waiting; Thistledown, about 2,430 euros waiting in the Marshes; Millbrook, about 8,790 euros; the farther hives, about 6,270 euros. Amounts are for an illustrative month.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Artisans, the fields. Build on NAOMS. A €100 quest earns 100 patronage points, agreed beforehand. Patronage points can be staked on another hive. Under the lens: Taavi whistling; quests sized in euros.
items.spoken: Artisans, the fields. Build on NAOMS. A 100 euros quest earns 100 patronage points, agreed beforehand. Patronage points can be staked on another hive. Under the lens: Taavi whistling; quests sized in euros.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Partners and foundations, the aqueducts. What an app stands on: partner projects and open-source foundations. Appreciation flows along the aqueducts; how much is negotiated between hives, and generosity is the practice. Under the lens: two hives agreeing a flow.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Widths drawn as the hives have agreed; no fixed figure. Amounts are for an illustrative month.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Guilds, guild halls. A craft practised across hives, with a home base: a training centre and clubhouse. Under the lens: Mireille and her apprentices training.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Backers, the clouds and the gates. Backers bring water to the realm and receive tokens: €7 each, up to 144. At the gates, n votes on one hive cost n² tokens; each vote sends water into that hive's chest and brings its patronage points back. Giftable, never cashed out. Under the lens: Dagny: water in, tokens back, gates opening, patronage points returning.
items.spoken: Backers, the clouds and the gates. Backers bring water to the realm and receive tokens: 7 euros each, up to 144. At the gates, n votes on one hive cost n squared tokens; each vote sends water into that hive's chest and brings its patronage points back. Giftable, never cashed out. Under the lens: Dagny: water in, tokens back, gates opening, patronage points returning.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: This month: about €28,000 of backers' water from about 40 backers. Votes cast: 92; each vote sends about €304. Amounts are for an illustrative month.
items.spoken: This month: about 28,000 euros of backers' water from about 40 backers. Votes cast: 92; each vote sends about 304 euros. Amounts are for an illustrative month.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Investors, the Great River. Larger capital enters through a fund. Investors cast no votes; the fund managers decide. Under the lens: Osei's trunk; a wide river splitting into many streams.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: From €10,000 each. Amounts are for an illustrative month.
items.spoken: From 10,000 euros each. Amounts are for an illustrative month.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Fund managers, the lakes. Raise a fund and decide how it is spent, four ways: into a chest, to a quest, toward a star, or matching. Hives answer with patronage points; the fund reinvests. No water passes between a fund and the Treasury, and there can be many funds. Under the lens: Priya dealing coins into neat piles.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: This month: about €6,000 into Hearthfield's chest, €3,000 into Riverbend's, €1,500 to quests, €1,500 matching. Amounts are for an illustrative month.
items.spoken: This month: about 6,000 euros into Hearthfield's chest, 3,000 euros into Riverbend's, 1,500 euros to quests, 1,500 euros matching. Amounts are for an illustrative month.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Connectors, the roads. Bring investors to a fund and receive 7% of the investment. Bringing a member through the Gate carries no coin. Under the lens: Ferran on the mountain road.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Patronage points, the granaries. Patronage points, earned one-for-one with euros and filled over time by patronage point payouts: when a hive pays out, holders share it in proportion to patronage points held (100 of 5,000 means 2%), up to a cap the hive sets, higher while new and smaller once selling. Patronage points are filled, paid towards and paid out on. Under the lens: a pro-rata split; a cap meter.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The Harbour Market, the app store. Apps stand in three states: for sale (80% to the hive, 20% to the Treasury), free to members (the millrace runs), and in the commons (free for all). Under the lens: a sale splitting; an app sailing out.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The planting calendar: free to members. The mill map: free to members. The ferry timetable: for sale. The lamp-lighter: in the workshop. Amounts are for an illustrative month.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Ancestors, the Grove. Each hive lists everyone who took part in creating its work, agrees in advance how incoming money is shared with them, and sends them appreciation from its chest. NAOMS's own ancestors receive appreciation from the Treasury here. Everyone listed is invited to accept. Under the lens: Agnes opening her envelope among the trees.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: All names invented. Amounts are for an illustrative month.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The Marshes. Where flow gets stuck: a decision pending. Under the lens: water pooling.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Thistledown's water waits here for a decision. Amounts are for an illustrative month.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The Open Sea, the commons. Apps that need no more revenue become free for all, their makers already at work on the next version. Under the lens: apps drifting free.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Move the time scrubber to watch apps sail out here. Amounts are for an illustrative month.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Hearthfield. A hive of farmers and coders. Its planting calendar is free to members and well used, so its millrace runs wide. Its ancestors are thanked through the Grove, and its partners and foundations along the aqueducts.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Into its chest this month, all amounts about: From the backers' votes at its gate: 22 votes, about €6,700. Down the millrace, for its app that is free to members: about €10,700. The referral share, 20% of lifetime memberships bought on its referral: about €656. From a fund, into its chest: about €6,000. Out of its chest, in order: patronage point payouts, then appreciation through the Grove and along the aqueducts.
items.spoken: Into its chest this month, all amounts about: From the backers' votes at its gate: 22 votes, about 6,700 euros. Down the millrace, for its app that is free to members: about 10,700 euros. The referral share, 20% of lifetime memberships bought on its referral: about 656 euros. From a fund, into its chest: about 6,000 euros. Out of its chest, in order: patronage point payouts, then appreciation through the Grove and along the aqueducts.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Riverbend. A hive that sells its ferry timetable in the Harbour Market: 80% of each sale comes to its chest and 20% to the Treasury. Sold apps draw no millrace.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Into its chest this month, all amounts about: From the backers' votes at its gate: 30 votes, about €9,130. The referral share, 20% of lifetime memberships bought on its referral: about €375. From a fund, into its chest: about €3,000. 80% of its app sales in the Harbour Market: about €8,000. Out of its chest, in order: patronage point payouts, then appreciation through the Grove and along the aqueducts.
items.spoken: Into its chest this month, all amounts about: From the backers' votes at its gate: 30 votes, about 9,130 euros. The referral share, 20% of lifetime memberships bought on its referral: about 375 euros. From a fund, into its chest: about 3,000 euros. 80% of its app sales in the Harbour Market: about 8,000 euros. Out of its chest, in order: patronage point payouts, then appreciation through the Grove and along the aqueducts.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Lanternhill. Wren's hive. She opened it as its Hive Instigator, and its workshop is building the lamp-lighter app.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Lanternhill. A hive site, waiting for a Hive Instigator.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: No chest yet: the site waits for a Hive Instigator.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Thistledown. A new hive. A decision is pending, so for now the water sent to it waits in the Marshes.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Into its chest this month, all amounts about: From the backers' votes at its gate: 8 votes, about €2,430. Its water waits in the Marshes until a decision is made. Out of its chest, in order: patronage point payouts, then appreciation through the Grove and along the aqueducts.
items.spoken: Into its chest this month, all amounts about: From the backers' votes at its gate: 8 votes, about 2,430 euros. Its water waits in the Marshes until a decision is made. Out of its chest, in order: patronage point payouts, then appreciation through the Grove and along the aqueducts.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Millbrook. A hive whose mill map is free to members. It builds on Lanternhill's work, so appreciation runs along the aqueduct between them, as the two hives agreed.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Into its chest this month, all amounts about: From the backers' votes at its gate: 12 votes, about €3,650. Down the millrace, for its app that is free to members: about €4,860. The referral share, 20% of lifetime memberships bought on its referral: about €281. Out of its chest, in order: patronage point payouts, then appreciation through the Grove and along the aqueducts.
items.spoken: Into its chest this month, all amounts about: From the backers' votes at its gate: 12 votes, about 3,650 euros. Down the millrace, for its app that is free to members: about 4,860 euros. The referral share, 20% of lifetime memberships bought on its referral: about 281 euros. Out of its chest, in order: patronage point payouts, then appreciation through the Grove and along the aqueducts.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The farther hives. 12-14 projects are building on NAOMS. These hamlets stand for the hives beyond the five named ones, each with its own chest and its own gate.
items.spoken: The farther hives. 12 to 14 projects are building on NAOMS. These hamlets stand for the hives beyond the five named ones, each with its own chest and its own gate.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Into its chest this month, all amounts about: From the backers' votes at its gate: 20 votes, about €6,090. The referral share, 20% of lifetime memberships bought on its referral: about €188. Out of its chest, in order: patronage point payouts, then appreciation through the Grove and along the aqueducts.
items.spoken: Into its chest this month, all amounts about: From the backers' votes at its gate: 20 votes, about 6,090 euros. The referral share, 20% of lifetime memberships bought on its referral: about 188 euros. Out of its chest, in order: patronage point payouts, then appreciation through the Grove and along the aqueducts.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The four ways a fund directs money. A fund spreads its water: one investment of 10,000 euros becomes 2,000 here, 1,000 there, and smaller sums to quests. Its managers choose among four ways.
items.where: Pop-out: The four ways a fund directs money

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Into a hive's chest. You decide: the hive uses the money as it sees fit, within its own culture and rules.
items.where: Pop-out: The four ways a fund directs money

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: To a quest. A specific piece of work, sized in euros, done by an artisan who earns the hive's patronage points for it.
items.where: Pop-out: The four ways a fund directs money

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Toward a star. A purpose the fund names; hives line up behind it by proposing quests that serve it.
items.where: Pop-out: The four ways a fund directs money

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Matching. The fund matches what others put in, such as a hive's own backers.
items.where: Pop-out: The four ways a fund directs money

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Hives answer a fund's water with patronage points, and the fund reinvests what returns. The point of a fund is to become a river.
items.where: Pop-out: The four ways a fund directs money

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The Council's panel. Decided by discernment each period; no rule. Each period the Council looks at what the Treasury has received from dues and at the whole realm, and decides what serves the greatest good. These are the gates it tends.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The Forge. To cover the infrastructure's costs, up to the floor the Council sets. Top-down pressure meets the Forge team's bottom-up needs.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The millraces. To the hives whose apps are free to members, in proportion to use, covering costs and filling the patronage points those apps issued.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The payout and appreciation line. To pay out on patronage points already held in NAOMS, and to give appreciation to NAOMS's own ancestors in the Grove.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The surplus. Once the Forge and the free apps have what they need: invested directly in a hive's project, or matching what others put in, for patronage points the cooperative holds.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Sometimes the Forge's floor fills first, sometimes the millraces run first. The positions shown are illustrative.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The patronage points calculator. Patronage points are earned one for one with euros, and filled over time by patronage point payouts shared in proportion to patronage points held.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Earning. A quest's euros become the same number of patronage points, agreed before the work.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: A quest of €100 earns 100 patronage points, agreed before the work.
items.spoken: A quest of 100 euros earns 100 patronage points, agreed before the work.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: A patronage point payout. When a hive pays out, each holder receives a share in proportion to the patronage points they hold.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Holding 100 of the 5,000 patronage points this hive has issued is 2% of them, so a payout of €1,000 brings you about €20.
items.spoken: Holding 100 of the 5,000 patronage points this hive has issued is 2% of them, so a payout of 1,000 euros brings you about 20 euros.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Cap on what a point can return: set by the hive, higher while the work is new, smaller once its app is selling.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The voting toy. On one hive, n votes cost n² tokens. Many small voices outweigh one loud one.
items.spoken: The voting toy. On one hive, n votes cost n squared tokens. Many small voices outweigh one loud one.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: 12 votes on this hive cost 144 tokens and bring 840 patronage points. No tokens stay in hand. Spread instead, 144 tokens cast one vote on each of 144 hives.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: One person spending 100 tokens on one hive casts 10 votes.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: 25 people spending 4 tokens each cast 50 votes.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: 144 tokens: 12 votes on one hive, or one vote each on 144 hives.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: These dials are for seeing, and every position on them is illustrative. In the realm the Council decides by discernment each period, with no rule.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Fixed, and shown as such: Referral share: 20% of a lifetime fee bought on a hive's referral (92 of 460 euros); App sales: 80% to the hive's chest, 20% to the Treasury; Connectors: 7% of an investment they bring to a fund; Flow Tokens: 7 euros each, up to 144.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The legend. River: money, flowing. Width shows about how much. Millrace: the usage stream to free apps. Gold channel: payouts and appreciation. Deep green channel: a fund's water. Straight canal: the referral share. Chest: a hive's treasury. Token: a Flow Token. Wax seal: a membership token. Ticket: patronage points. Ochre path: a patronage point payout, cash to patronage point holders. Grey cloud: Flow Token money, falling as rain. Aqueduct: what an app stands on. Hall: a guild's home. Stall: an app in the Harbour Market. Gold thread: appreciation to the Grove. A drawn character: a role you can follow.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Who decides. The Council divides the dues by discernment, sets the Forge's budget and decides where the surplus goes. Backers steer their own water with Flow Tokens. Fund managers decide their fund. Each hive decides its payouts, its patronage points and caps, its apps' prices, and its aqueducts. Each patronage point holder decides where their own payouts go. The referral share and the 20% on app sales are structure.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Every amount here is illustrative: an invented month in an invented realm, drawn to show how the water moves. All people, hives and apps are invented.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Move through the months: the Forge's river holds its width while the realm's water grows, millraces widen, apps fill their patronage points and sail into the Open Sea, and hives begin new versions.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Month 12: about €71,300 of dues a month. The Forge's river about €15,000, its floor €15,000; the millraces about €21,900. In the commons by now: the planting calendar, the ferry timetable, the mill map.
items.spoken: Month 12: about 71,300 euros of dues a month. The Forge's river about 15,000 euros, its floor 15,000 euros; the millraces about 21,900 euros. In the commons by now: the planting calendar, the ferry timetable, the mill map.
items.where: Time scrubber (an example month; spoken by the browser when it changes)

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Prepare: hives list their ancestors and agree their shares before the first euro moves, and the terms for memberships and tokens are set.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Pre-sale: memberships are offered to members, partners, their networks, friends and family, and the springs begin to run.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Attribution invitations: everyone on a hive's list is invited to log in, accept, and see what their work grew into.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Flow Tokens and voting: backers bring water, receive tokens, and steer it at the gates.
items.where: The round: Flow Tokens and voting

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Funds and follow-on: investors come down the Great River into funds, and the round continues.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Each possible future sets the Council's dials and how fast the springs grow: a possibility the group has yet to choose between. Pick one, then move through the months.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Steady springs: membership grows at a steady pace and the Council's hand rests where it is today. A possibility the group has yet to choose between.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: A warm welcome: the springs multiply quickly. The Forge's floor stays where it is, so its river holds while everything around it widens. A possibility the group has yet to choose between.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: A quiet season: the springs grow slowly, and the Forge's floor takes most of the water for a while. A possibility the group has yet to choose between.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Generous millraces: the Council leans towards the free apps, and they reach the commons sooner. A possibility the group has yet to choose between.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: Forge first: the Council raises the Forge's floor to build out the infrastructure, and the apps take longer to fill. A possibility the group has yet to choose between.

items.speaker: narrator
items.name: The narrator
items.text: The Gate is open. You have walked the realm. The NAOMS cooperative invites you to join it: 20 euros a month, lifetime after 31 months, or 460 euros at once for life. Someone who knows the work will vouch for you. Come in. On the round's invite-only website, this is where you would join.
